Controller Contracts

This page provides the addresses and deployed chain details of Asset Controller contracts, which can be used with the Lucid Wrapper contract to bridge assets across chains. For bridging assets managed by Asset Controllers, refer to this page.

A controller contract uses the same address across all chains where it is deployed.
